item.title: Ohio State Defensive Tackle Eric Mensah Entering Transfer Portal After Two Years As Buckeye
item.description: Eric Mensah is leaving Ohio State after two years as a Buckeye. The backup defensive tackle announced Friday on X that he is entering the transfer portal. I want to thank Coach Day, especially Coach Johnson, the weight room staff, and the nutrition staff for the opportunity to wear the scarlet and gray but also helping me grow as a man and teaching me a lot. However, I will be taking my talents elsewhere. As always Go Bucks!!! pic.twitter.com/3JyTduZO78 — Eric Mensah (@EricMen85258722) January 9

item.description: A small amount of early playing time was not enough to keep defensive tackle Jarquez Carter from seeking other opportunities after one year at Ohio State. On Friday, Carter entered the transfer portal after playing in seven games as a freshman for the Buckeyes. item.title: Ohio State Safety Malik Hartford Enters the Transfer Portal
item.description: One of Ohio State’s top safeties will continue his football career at another school. Malik Hartford entered the transfer portal on Friday. The 6-foot-3, 200-pound safety is the 25th scholarship Buckeye to enter the portal since it opened on Jan. 2. Ohio State safety Malik Hartford has entered the transfer portal, @mzenitz and I have learned for @CBSSports. Hartford was a top 70 recruit and the No. 5 safety in the 2023 class. Has posted 20 tackles and 3 PDs in his career. https://t.co/Ycv2m0d2P7

item.title: Ohio State Wide Receiver Bodpegn Miller Enters Transfer Portal After One Year As Buckeye
item.description: Ohio State has now lost six members of its 2025 recruiting class after just one season. Bodpegn Miller told ESPN on Friday that he is entering the transfer portal, becoming the sixth member of Ohio State’s 2025 class to enter the portal for 2026. Ohio State WR Bodpegn Miller plans to enter the transfer portal, a source tells ESPN. The 6-3 196 freshman joined the Buckeyes as a 4-star ATH recruit and redshirted this season. Miller has 4 more years of eligibility. pic.twitter.com/iLXRqDJM8d — Max O
